description.value: The Ruby is a locally owned scratch brunch restaurant with three Victoria locations, open since 2015 and built around relationships with local suppliers. It offers a refined take on eclectic southern brunch fare paired with the city's best vinyl collection and warmly attentive service. A touring cyclist arriving hungry would find generous, hearty dishes with strong vegan and gluten-free options well-suited to refuelling.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (16 spaces, covered) at 62m; rack (16 spaces, covered) at 83m. Total: 32 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Ruby is an active multi-location brunch restaurant with three Victoria locations (642A Johnson Street, 3110 Douglas Street, 328 Wale Road); the OSM node carries no address, making it impossible to determine which location this record represents. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
